notes: Closed-loop local HTTP experiment against the direct Go API, excluding Next.js. POST latency includes connection, response headers/body, and JSON decoding; cancellation, integrity snapshots, and warmup are excluded from individual POST samples. Percentiles include failed requests if any. Total experiment time includes cancellation and integrity snapshots. No requests-per-second capacity claim is made. Saturation retains reservations until round end; lifecycle cancels each assigned ride before that worker's next POST. Mixed demand uses every fifth pickup outside the original fleet radius. Existing history, logging, pool size, and cache state can affect results. This does not model real traffic, routing, or production capacity.
